title: Working Door
description: A door that opens when a player touches it and closes after a few seconds.
steps: Insert a Part, resize it into a door shape, and name it Door.
Turn on Anchored in the Properties window.
Insert a Script into the Door and paste the script below.
Press Play and walk into the door.

scripts.name: DoorScript
scripts.code:
local door = script.Parent
local open = false

door.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	if hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and not open then
		open = true
		door.Transparency = 0.7
		door.CanCollide = false
		task.wait(3)
		door.Transparency = 0
		door.CanCollide = true
		open = false
	end
end)

notes: If the door falls over, make sure Anchored is on.
Replace the example model ID with your own.

title: Day and Night Cycle
description: Make the sun and sky change smoothly from morning to night, over and over.
steps: Open your game in Roblox Studio.
In the Explorer window, find ServerScriptService.
Hover over ServerScriptService, tap the + button, and choose Script.
Delete the starter code inside the script.
Paste the script below.
Change DAY_LENGTH to make the day faster or slower. 120 means a full day takes 2 minutes.
Press Play and watch the sky change.

scripts.name: DayNightCycle
scripts.code:
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local DAY_LENGTH = 120 -- seconds for one full day
local START_TIME = 6 -- starts at 6 AM

Lighting.ClockTime = START_TIME

while true do
	local step = 24 / DAY_LENGTH * 0.1
	Lighting.ClockTime = (Lighting.ClockTime + step) % 24
	task.wait(0.1)
end

notes: Put the script in ServerScriptService, not inside a Part, or it won't run properly.
For a nicer sunset, add a Sky object inside Lighting and turn on Atmosphere.

title: Sprint and Stamina Bar (PC + Mobile)
description: Hold Shift or the on-screen RUN button to sprint while a sleek stamina bar drains, turns red when low, and refills when you rest.
steps: Open your game in Roblox Studio.
In the Explorer window, find StarterPlayer, then StarterPlayerScripts inside it.
Hover over StarterPlayerScripts, tap the + button, and choose LocalScript.
Delete the starter code inside the LocalScript.
Paste the script below. It builds the whole bar and the mobile button by itself, so you don't need to make any UI by hand.
Change the numbers at the top to tune the speed, drain, and refill.
Press Play. On PC hold Left Shift while moving. On mobile hold the RUN button while moving.

scripts.name: SprintStamina
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local UserInputService = game:GetService('UserInputService')
local TweenService = game:GetService('TweenService')
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Settings (change these)
local WALK_SPEED = 16
local SPRINT_SPEED = 28
local MAX_STAMINA = 100
local DRAIN_RATE = 25 -- lost per second while sprinting
local REGEN_RATE = 15 -- gained per second while resting
local REGEN_DELAY = 1 -- seconds before it starts refilling
local RECOVER_AT = 25 -- stamina needed after getting tired
local NORMAL_FOV = 70
local SPRINT_FOV = 80

local stamina = MAX_STAMINA
local keyHeld = false
local buttonHeld = false
local exhausted = false
local lastSprint = 0
local barVisible = false
local fovBoosted = false

local DARK = Color3.fromRGB(18, 20, 28)
local CYAN = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255)
local RED = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70)
local info = TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)

-- Build the UI
local gui = Instance.new('ScreenGui')
gui.Name = 'StaminaUI'
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild('PlayerGui')

local holder = Instance.new('CanvasGroup')
holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
holder.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -40)
holder.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 24)
holder.BackgroundColor3 = DARK
holder.GroupTransparency = 1
holder.Parent = gui
Instance.new('UICorner', holder).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

local fill = Instance.new('Frame')
fill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
fill.BackgroundColor3 = CYAN
fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
fill.Parent = holder
Instance.new('UICorner', fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

local shine = Instance.new('UIGradient')
shine.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150))
shine.Rotation = 90
shine.Parent = fill

local label = Instance.new('TextLabel')
label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
label.Text = 'Stamina'
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
label.TextSize = 13
label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.6
label.ZIndex = 2
label.Parent = holder

-- Mobile sprint button (only shows on touch devices)
local sprintButton = Instance.new('TextButton')
sprintButton.Name = 'SprintButton'
sprintButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
sprintButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -35, 1, -190) -- move this to place the button
sprintButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 84, 0, 84)
sprintButton.BackgroundColor3 = DARK
sprintButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
sprintButton.AutoButtonColor = false
sprintButton.Text = 'RUN'
sprintButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
sprintButton.TextSize = 18
sprintButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
sprintButton.Visible = UserInputService.TouchEnabled
sprintButton.Parent = gui
Instance.new('UICorner', sprintButton).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

local stroke = Instance.new('UIStroke')
stroke.Color = CYAN
stroke.Thickness = 3
stroke.Parent = sprintButton

local function pressButton(down)
  buttonHeld = down
  TweenService:Create(sprintButton, info, {
    BackgroundColor3 = down and CYAN or DARK,
    TextColor3 = down and DARK or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
  }):Play()
end

local function isPress(input)
  return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
end

sprintButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
  if isPress(input) then pressButton(true) end
end)

sprintButton.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
  if isPress(input) then pressButton(false) end
end)

-- Smooth animations
local function showBar(show)
  if show == barVisible then return end
  barVisible = show
  TweenService:Create(holder, info, {GroupTransparency = show and 0 or 1}):Play()
end

local function boostFov(on)
  if on == fovBoosted then return end
  fovBoosted = on
  TweenService:Create(workspace.CurrentCamera, info, {FieldOfView = on and SPRINT_FOV or NORMAL_FOV}):Play()
end

-- Keyboard input (Left Shift)
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
  if processed then return end
  if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
    keyHeld = true
  end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
  if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
    keyHeld = false
  end
end)

-- Main loop
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
  local char = player.Character
  local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
  if not hum then return end

  local wantsSprint = keyHeld or buttonHeld
  local moving = hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0
  local sprinting = wantsSprint and moving and not exhausted

  if sprinting then
    stamina = math.max(0, stamina - DRAIN_RATE * dt)
    lastSprint = os.clock()
    hum.WalkSpeed = SPRINT_SPEED
    if stamina <= 0 then
      exhausted = true
    end
  else
    hum.WalkSpeed = WALK_SPEED
    if os.clock() - lastSprint > REGEN_DELAY then
      stamina = math.min(MAX_STAMINA, stamina + REGEN_RATE * dt)
      if exhausted and stamina >= RECOVER_AT then
        exhausted = false
      end
    end
  end

  -- Update the bar and button
  local ratio = stamina / MAX_STAMINA
  fill.Size = UDim2.new(ratio, 0, 1, 0)
  fill.BackgroundColor3 = exhausted and RED or RED:Lerp(CYAN, ratio)
  label.Text = exhausted and 'Tired!' or 'Stamina'
  sprintButton.TextTransparency = exhausted and 0.5 or 0
  stroke.Color = exhausted and RED or CYAN

  showBar(sprinting or stamina < MAX_STAMINA)
  boostFov(sprinting)
end)

notes: This is a LocalScript, so it must go in StarterPlayerScripts. A normal Script will not work.
The RUN button only appears on phones and tablets. To test it in Studio, open the Test tab, choose Device, and pick a phone.
If the RUN button sits on top of the jump button, change the Position line (the -190 value) to move it.
The bar hides itself when stamina is full, and it fades back in when you run.
If the camera looks wrong, set NORMAL_FOV to match your game's field of view (the Roblox default is 70).

title: Custom Shift Lock (PC + Mobile)
description: Lock the camera over the shoulder so your character always faces where you look, with a toggle key and an on-screen LOCK button for phones.
steps: Open your game in Roblox Studio.
In the Explorer window, find StarterPlayer, then StarterPlayerScripts inside it.
Hover over StarterPlayerScripts, tap the + button, and choose LocalScript.
Delete the starter code inside the LocalScript.
Paste the script below.
Change TOGGLE_KEY if you want a different key, and CAMERA_OFFSET to move the camera closer or further over the shoulder.
Press Play. On PC press Left Control to turn it on or off. On mobile tap the LOCK button.

scripts.name: CustomShiftLock
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local UserInputService = game:GetService('UserInputService')
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- Settings (change these)
local TOGGLE_KEY = Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl
local CAMERA_OFFSET = Vector3.new(1.75, 0.5, 0) -- shoulder view

local CYAN = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255)
local DARK = Color3.fromRGB(18, 20, 28)
local GREY = Color3.fromRGB(80, 85, 100)

local locked = false

local function applyLock(on)
  locked = on
  local char = player.Character
  local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
  if hum then
    hum.AutoRotate = not on
    hum.CameraOffset = on and CAMERA_OFFSET or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
  end
  if not on then
    UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
  end
end

-- Toggle button (shows on phones and tablets)
local gui = Instance.new('ScreenGui')
gui.Name = 'ShiftLockUI'
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild('PlayerGui')

local button = Instance.new('TextButton')
button.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
button.Position = UDim2.new(1, -35, 1, -290)
button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 56, 0, 56)
button.BackgroundColor3 = DARK
button.AutoButtonColor = false
button.Text = 'LOCK'
button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
button.TextSize = 13
button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
button.Visible = UserInputService.TouchEnabled
button.Parent = gui
Instance.new('UICorner', button).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

local stroke = Instance.new('UIStroke')
stroke.Color = GREY
stroke.Thickness = 3
stroke.Parent = button

local function toggle()
  applyLock(not locked)
  stroke.Color = locked and CYAN or GREY
end

button.Activated:Connect(toggle)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
  if processed then return end
  if input.KeyCode == TOGGLE_KEY then
    toggle()
  end
end)

-- Turn the character toward where the camera looks
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
  if not locked then return end
  local char = player.Character
  local root = char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
  if not root then return end
  UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
  local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
  root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position, root.Position + Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z))
end)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
  task.wait()
  applyLock(locked)
end)

notes: This is a LocalScript, so it must go in StarterPlayerScripts.
The key is Left Control, not Shift, so it does not clash with the Sprint tutorial. You can change TOGGLE_KEY to anything.
Roblox also has a built-in shift lock. It is the EnableMouseLockOption property on StarterPlayer, and players use the Shift key. Use this script when you want your own key and a mobile button.
The LOCK button sits above the RUN button. Change the -290 value in Position to move it.
On phones the camera is turned by dragging the screen, and the character follows where the camera points.

title: Coin Collector with Leaderboard
description: Touch coins to earn points that show on the player list, and the coins come back after a few seconds.
steps: Open your game in Roblox Studio.
In ServerScriptService, add a Script named Leaderstats and paste Script 1 below.
Insert a Part, make it a flat gold coin shape, and name it Coin.
Turn on Anchored and turn off CanCollide so players walk through it.
Insert a Script into the Coin and paste Script 2 below.
Copy and paste the Coin as many times as you want around the map.
Press Play and walk into the coins. Your Coins number shows in the top right.

scripts.name: Leaderstats
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService('Players')

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
  local stats = Instance.new('Folder')
  stats.Name = 'leaderstats'
  stats.Parent = player

  local coins = Instance.new('IntValue')
  coins.Name = 'Coins'
  coins.Value = 0
  coins.Parent = stats
end)

scripts.name: CoinScript
scripts.code:
local coin = script.Parent
local VALUE = 1 -- coins given per pickup
local RESPAWN_TIME = 5 -- seconds until the coin returns
local collected = false

coin.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
  if collected then return end

  local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
  if not player then return end

  collected = true
  player.leaderstats.Coins.Value += VALUE

  coin.Transparency = 1
  task.wait(RESPAWN_TIME)
  coin.Transparency = 0
  collected = false
end)

notes: The folder must be named leaderstats in lowercase, or Roblox will not show the scoreboard.
If you add the Save Data tutorial later, delete the Leaderstats script from this one. The Save Data script creates leaderstats already.
Change VALUE to make rare coins worth more.

title: Checkpoint System
description: Players respawn at the last checkpoint they touched, perfect for obbies.
steps: Open your game in Roblox Studio.
In the Model tab, choose Spawn to insert a SpawnLocation. Name it Checkpoint1.
In the Properties window, turn on Anchored, turn off Neutral, and set TeamColor if you use teams. For a game with no teams, leave Neutral on.
Insert a Script into the Checkpoint and paste the script below.
Copy and paste the Checkpoint further along your obby and rename each one.
Press Play, touch a checkpoint, then reset your character. You should respawn there.

scripts.name: CheckpointScript
scripts.code:
local checkpoint = script.Parent

checkpoint.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
  local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
  if player and player.RespawnLocation ~= checkpoint then
    player.RespawnLocation = checkpoint
  end
end)

notes: The checkpoint must be a SpawnLocation, not a normal Part, or RespawnLocation will not work.
Keep Neutral on if your game has no teams.
Put the main spawn at the start of the map so new players begin there.

title: Teleport Pad
description: Step on a pad and get teleported to another spot in your map.
steps: Open your game in Roblox Studio.
Insert a Part for the pad and name it TeleportPad. Turn on Anchored.
Insert another Part where you want players to land and name it TeleportDestination. Turn on Anchored.
Make sure TeleportDestination is directly inside Workspace, not inside a model.
Insert a Script into TeleportPad and paste the script below.
Press Play and step on the pad.

scripts.name: TeleportScript
scripts.code:
local pad = script.Parent
local destination = workspace:WaitForChild('TeleportDestination')
local COOLDOWN = 2 -- seconds before the pad works again
local busy = false

pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
  if busy then return end

  local hum = hit.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
  local root = hit.Parent:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
  if not hum or not root then return end

  busy = true
  root.CFrame = destination.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
  task.wait(COOLDOWN)
  busy = false
end)

notes: The + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0) lifts players above the destination so they do not get stuck inside it.
For two-way teleporting, make a second pad that sends players back to the first one.
Turn off CanCollide on the destination if you want it to be invisible.

title: Lava Brick
description: A brick that hurts or instantly kills players who touch it.
steps: Open your game in Roblox Studio.
Insert a Part, set its Material to Neon, and set the Color to orange or red.
Turn on Anchored.
Insert a Script into the Part and paste the script below.
Set DAMAGE to 100 to kill instantly, or something like 10 for slow damage.
Press Play and touch the lava.

scripts.name: LavaScript
scripts.code:
local lava = script.Parent
local DAMAGE = 100 -- 100 kills instantly, 10 hurts slowly
local DELAY = 1 -- seconds between hits on the same player
local recentlyHit = {}

lava.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
  local hum = hit.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
  if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
  if recentlyHit[hum] then return end

  recentlyHit[hum] = true
  hum:TakeDamage(DAMAGE)
  task.wait(DELAY)
  recentlyHit[hum] = nil
end)

notes: Players with a ForceField, like the spawn protection one, take no damage.
Copy the same brick for every lava part so you only write the script once.

title: Shop GUI with Cash
description: Open a shop menu and buy upgrades with cash. The server checks every purchase so exploiters cannot cheat.
steps: Open your game in Roblox Studio.
In ServerScriptService, add a Script named ShopServer and paste Script 1 below. It makes the cash leaderboard and a RemoteEvent for you.
In StarterPlayer → StarterPlayerScripts, add a LocalScript named ShopClient and paste Script 2 below. It builds the whole menu by itself.
Press Play, tap the Shop button on the left, and buy an item.
To add items, add a price to the ITEMS list in the server script, add a matching line in giveItem, and add an addItem line in the client script.

scripts.name: ShopServer
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')

-- Prices live on the server so players cannot cheat
local ITEMS = {
  HighJump = 100,
  Glow = 50,
}

local buyEvent = Instance.new('RemoteEvent')
buyEvent.Name = 'BuyItem'
buyEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
  local stats = Instance.new('Folder')
  stats.Name = 'leaderstats'
  stats.Parent = player

  local cash = Instance.new('IntValue')
  cash.Name = 'Cash'
  cash.Value = 200 -- starting cash
  cash.Parent = stats
end)

local function giveItem(player, itemName)
  local char = player.Character
  local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
  local root = char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
  if not hum or not root then return false end

  if itemName == 'HighJump' then
    hum.UseJumpPower = true
    hum.JumpPower = 90
  elseif itemName == 'Glow' then
    local light = Instance.new('PointLight')
    light.Range = 20
    light.Brightness = 3
    light.Parent = root
  end
  return true
end

buyEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, itemName)
  local price = ITEMS[itemName]
  if not price then return end

  local cash = player.leaderstats.Cash
  if cash.Value >= price and giveItem(player, itemName) then
    cash.Value -= price
  end
end)

scripts.name: ShopClient
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local buyEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild('BuyItem')

local DARK = Color3.fromRGB(18, 20, 28)
local CYAN = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255)

local gui = Instance.new('ScreenGui')
gui.Name = 'ShopUI'
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild('PlayerGui')

local openButton = Instance.new('TextButton')
openButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 40)
openButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0.5, 0)
openButton.BackgroundColor3 = CYAN
openButton.Text = 'Shop'
openButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
openButton.TextSize = 16
openButton.TextColor3 = DARK
openButton.Parent = gui
Instance.new('UICorner', openButton).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

local frame = Instance.new('Frame')
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 230, 0, 150)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 115, 0.5, 0)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = DARK
frame.Visible = false
frame.Parent = gui
Instance.new('UICorner', frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

local layout = Instance.new('UIListLayout')
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
layout.Parent = frame

local padding = Instance.new('UIPadding')
padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 12)
padding.Parent = frame

local function addItem(itemName, label)
  local b = Instance.new('TextButton')
  b.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 44)
  b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 44, 58)
  b.Text = label
  b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
  b.TextSize = 15
  b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
  b.Parent = frame
  Instance.new('UICorner', b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
  b.Activated:Connect(function()
    buyEvent:FireServer(itemName)
  end)
end

addItem('HighJump', 'High Jump - 100 Cash')
addItem('Glow', 'Glow - 50 Cash')

openButton.Activated:Connect(function()
  frame.Visible = not frame.Visible
end)

notes: Never trust the client. The client only says which item it wants, and the server checks the price and takes the cash.
The upgrades reset when you die. To keep them, save the items in a DataStore (see the Save Data tutorial).
If you use the Coin Collector tutorial, delete its Leaderstats script. This one already creates leaderstats, and you can add a Coins value next to Cash.
This shop does not touch WalkSpeed, so it works alongside the Sprint tutorial.

title: Save Player Data (DataStore)
description: Save and load Coins and Level between sessions with retries, autosave, and a safe shutdown save.
steps: Publish your game to Roblox first. DataStores do not work in an unsaved place.
In Studio, open Game Settings → Security and turn on Enable Studio Access to API Services. Save.
In ServerScriptService, add a Script named PlayerData and paste the script below.
If you already made a leaderstats script from another tutorial, delete it. This script creates leaderstats with Coins and Level.
Press Play, change your Coins value in the Explorer (under the Players folder), then stop and play again to see it saved.
Check the Output window for any warnings. Failed saves print there.

scripts.name: PlayerData
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local DataStoreService = game:GetService('DataStoreService')

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore('PlayerData_v1')

local AUTOSAVE_SECONDS = 60
local RETRIES = 3
local DEFAULT_DATA = { Coins = 0, Level = 1 }

local sessionData = {}

local function loadData(userId)
  for attempt = 1, RETRIES do
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
      return store:GetAsync('Player_' .. userId)
    end)
    if ok then
      return result or table.clone(DEFAULT_DATA)
    end
    warn('Load failed (try ' .. attempt .. '): ' .. tostring(result))
    task.wait(2)
  end
  return nil
end

local function saveData(player)
  local data = sessionData[player.UserId]
  local stats = player:FindFirstChild('leaderstats')
  if not data or not stats then return end

  data.Coins = stats.Coins.Value
  data.Level = stats.Level.Value

  for attempt = 1, RETRIES do
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
      store:SetAsync('Player_' .. player.UserId, data)
    end)
    if ok then return end
    warn('Save failed (try ' .. attempt .. '): ' .. tostring(err))
    task.wait(2)
  end
end

local function onJoin(player)
  local data = loadData(player.UserId)
  if not data then
    player:Kick('Could not load your data. Please rejoin.')
    return
  end
  sessionData[player.UserId] = data

  local stats = Instance.new('Folder')
  stats.Name = 'leaderstats'

  local coins = Instance.new('IntValue')
  coins.Name = 'Coins'
  coins.Value = data.Coins
  coins.Parent = stats

  local level = Instance.new('IntValue')
  level.Name = 'Level'
  level.Value = data.Level
  level.Parent = stats

  stats.Parent = player
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onJoin)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
  task.spawn(onJoin, player)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
  saveData(player)
  sessionData[player.UserId] = nil
end)

-- Autosave
task.spawn(function()
  while true do
    task.wait(AUTOSAVE_SECONDS)
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      task.spawn(saveData, player)
    end
  end
end)

-- Save everyone when the server shuts down
game:BindToClose(function()
  for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    task.spawn(saveData, player)
  end
  task.wait(3)
end)

notes: Everything goes through pcall because DataStore calls can fail. Without it, one failed request would crash the script.
If loading fails, the player is kicked instead of being given empty data. Otherwise their next save would wipe their real progress.
Change 'PlayerData_v1' to 'PlayerData_v2' if you ever want to reset everyone's data.
SetAsync is the simple option. For big games, upgrade to UpdateAsync and session locking so two servers cannot overwrite each other.
Works with the Coin Collector script. Its coins add to leaderstats.Coins, and this script saves that value.
